props.title: What Is Shiatsu Massage?
props.text: Shiatsu is a traditional Japanese massage that uses finger, thumb and palm pressure on specific points across the body, with gentle stretching and no oil. Instead of long oil strokes, your therapist works point by point to ease muscle tension and stiffness.
props.feature1Text: Applies focused pressure to specific areas using fingers, thumbs, and palms.
props.feature2Text: Supports flexibility while helping muscles release built-up tension.

props.title: Our Duration Options
props.text: Choose 30 minutes for the neck and shoulders, 1 hour for the full body, or 1.5 hours for slower, more detailed pressure-point work.

items.question: Does a shiatsu massage use oil?
items.answer: No. Traditional shiatsu is generally performed without massage oil, and shiatsu at Spa Bali Moon is oil-free. The treatment focuses on finger, thumb and palm pressure on specific points, with gentle stretching and body movement rather than long gliding strokes.

items.question: Is shiatsu suitable for beginners?
items.answer: Yes. At Spa Bali Moon, your therapist adjusts the pressure to your comfort. For a first shiatsu, 30 minutes is a good start, or choose 1 hour for the full body.

items.question: How is shiatsu different from a deep tissue massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu focuses on pressure points and gentle stretching using fingers, thumbs and palms, without oil, while deep tissue massage works deeper into muscles using slow pressure and muscle-specific techniques. At Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak, shiatsu costs IDR 219.000 for 1 hour and deep tissue massage IDR 269.000 for 1 hour, per person.

items.question: Can shiatsu help with stress?
items.answer: It may. Many guests choose shiatsu at Spa Bali Moon because the slow rhythm and controlled pressure encourage both physical relaxation and a calmer state of mind.

items.question: Can I combine shiatsu with other treatments?
items.answer: Yes. There is no set shiatsu package, but you can book shiatsu before or after another treatment, such as a body scrub or a facial. Tell us on WhatsApp what you'd like and we'll plan the times.

items.question: Is a shiatsu massage painful?
items.answer: It should not be. A shiatsu massage at Spa Bali Moon can feel firm or intense when pressure is applied to tense areas, but it should remain comfortable. The therapist works at a controlled pace and can adjust the finger, thumb and palm pressure based on your preference, so tell them if anything feels too strong.

items.question: What is shiatsu massage good for?
items.answer: Shiatsu can help ease muscle tension and help you relax, and it can leave your body feeling more comfortable and flexible. At Spa Bali Moon it suits guests after work, travel or exercise, with focus on areas such as the neck and shoulders, back, hips and legs.

items.question: When should I avoid a shiatsu massage?
items.answer: Shiatsu massage may not be suitable if you have certain medical conditions, injuries, or are recovering from surgery. If you are unsure whether it is right for you, consult a healthcare professional before your session. At Spa Bali Moon, tell your therapist about any health concerns first; pressure is always adjusted to your comfort.

items.question: How much does a shiatsu massage cost in Seminyak?
items.answer: IDR 119.000 for 30 minutes, IDR 219.000 for 1 hour and IDR 329.000 for 1.5 hours per person at Spa Bali Moon. Home service at your villa or hotel adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. You can pay by Visa, Mastercard or cash, and book your shiatsu massage on WhatsApp, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Is shiatsu the same as Japanese massage?
items.answer: At Spa Bali Moon, yes: our Japanese massage is shiatsu, the best-known Japanese massage technique. It is oil-free pressure-point work using fingers, thumbs and palms, with gentle stretching. Book it at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel for 30 minutes, 1 hour or 1.5 hours.

items.question: Where can I get a shiatsu massage in Seminyak?
items.answer: At Spa Bali Moon, Jl. Pangkung Sari No. 30, Seminyak, or at your villa or hotel, where home service adds IDR 75.000 per therapist in the Seminyak area. Our Seminyak spa has been in business since 2009 and is open daily, 9am to 11pm. Book your shiatsu massage on WhatsApp, +62 878-6317-5144.

items.question: How long does a shiatsu massage take?
items.answer: A shiatsu massage at Spa Bali Moon in Seminyak takes 30 minutes (IDR 119.000), 1 hour (IDR 219.000) or 1.5 hours (IDR 329.000) per person.

items.question: Can I have a shiatsu massage at my villa or hotel?
items.answer: Yes. A Spa Bali Moon therapist comes from our Seminyak spa to your villa, hotel or home with fresh linen and everything a shiatsu massage needs. It costs the same as at the spa, plus a home service fee of IDR 75.000 per therapist in Seminyak, Petitenget and Kerobokan, or IDR 150.000 in Canggu, North Kuta and Kuta. Book on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144, 9am to 11pm.

items.question: Can I book a shiatsu massage for today?
items.answer: Often, yes, depending on availability. Message us on WhatsApp at +62 878-6317-5144 between 9am and 11pm with the time you'd like. At our Seminyak spa we confirm the next free time; at a villa or hotel in the Seminyak area a therapist usually arrives within 30 to 60 minutes. For a set time, or for two or more guests, book earlier in the day.

items.question: Can I ask for a female or male therapist for my shiatsu massage?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us your preference when you book your shiatsu massage on WhatsApp and we'll arrange a female or male therapist, at our Seminyak spa or at your villa or hotel.
